fyke:
n. A long bag net distended by hoops, into which fish can pass
easily, without being able to return; -- called also fyke net.
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">荷蘭語 fuik（弓形網），源自中古荷蘭語 fūke、fuycke</dd></dl>
fylfot: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語，指填充彩繪窗下部區域的彩繪圖形，源自 fillen（填充）＋foot（足）</dd></dl>
fynbos: n. 高山硬葉灌木群落
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">南非荷蘭語，源自 fyn（細的、精緻的）＋ bos（灌木）</dd></dl>
